description: Get a single terse plain-text answer from Wolfram Alpha. Best for: arithmetic, unit conversion, "what is X", "how many Y in Z", factual lookups (planet diameter, country GDP, element atomic weight, current time in Tokyo). Returns one string.

examples.query: what is the capital of France

name: short_answer

answer.description: The terse plain-text answer, or null if not understood

message.description: Error or status message if answer is null

query.description: The query string that was sent to Wolfram Alpha

title: Short Answer
